$sources: SAEngine practice: bands of the reference peak ground acceleration agR (EN 1998-1 Sec 3.2.1) for the category of the seismic action; agR itself comes from the National Annex's zonation map
source: SAEngine practice: EN 1998-1 Sec 3.2.1 leaves agR to the National Annex map. The project enters agR (in g) as Z (Location: Custom); the zone is the band nearest to it (1: about 0.02 g, very low; 2: about 0.06 g, low; 3: about 0.10 g; 4: 0.30 g), used only for the category in seismic.designCategories
